name: replo
description: Replo — graph-first understanding for any GitHub repository: knowledge graph, diagrams and a sequenced course

scripts.verify: turbo run lint typecheck test build
scripts.cf:product:deploy: NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_PATH=/app NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=${NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL:-https://app.reploai.workers.dev} NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL=${NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL:-https://app.reploai.workers.dev/app} pnpm --filter @replo/product exec opennextjs-cloudflare build && node scripts/check-production-bundle.mjs product && pnpm --filter @replo/product exec wrangler deploy
scripts.cf:landing:deploy: NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL=${NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL:-https://app.reploai.workers.dev/app} NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL=${NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL:-https://app.reploai.workers.dev} pnpm --filter @replo/landing build && node scripts/check-production-bundle.mjs landing && pnpm --filter @replo/landing exec wrangler deploy
scripts.cf:deploy: pnpm cf:landing:deploy && pnpm cf:product:deploy && pnpm cf:pipeline:deploy && pnpm cf:api:deploy && pnpm cf:gateway:deploy
